description: **`go install ...@latest` no longer installs the retired tool.** The 0.7.0 retract interval `[v0.0.0, v0.7.0]` excluded pseudo-versions, so `@latest` still resolved to a pseudo-version built from the branch tip. The interval is now `[v0.0.0-0, v0.7.1]`, which starts below every possible pseudo-version and includes this release itself.
**Corrected a false claim in the 0.7.0 release notes.** They stated the PyPI releases were yanked; they are not. The notes now say the PyPI yank is pending and must be done manually.
